name: salary-management-platform
description: Internal salary management tool for ACME's HR manager

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm -w apps/api run db:deploy && npm -w apps/api run start:prod
scripts.test: npm -w apps/api run test && npm -w apps/web run test
scripts.setup: npm install && npm -w apps/api run db:reset
scripts.test:coverage: npm -w apps/api run test:coverage && npm -w apps/web run test:coverage
